title: A Bio-Inspired Proton-Relay Mechanism for Base-Induced Polyketide Ring Closure: a Hypothesis Inspired by the Aromatase/Cyclases TcmN and WhiE
description: Perspective preprint. We hypothesise that in base-induced cyclisation of poly-beta-carbonyl chains in protic media, the proton removed from the active methylene and the proton returned to the alkoxide travel along a hydrogen-bond chain by successive hops (Grotthuss-type relay), extending the single-water mechanism proposed for the aromatase/cyclases TcmN and WhiE. The paper gives the mechanism, evidence for and against, testable predictions and a computational test plan. It reports no new experimental or computational data.
